neighbours.label: talk of how something will be measured or evaluated against goals (how we will measure, metrics, evaluated, measurable)
fire: Each team must set targets and explain how progress will be assessed.
Which indicators will the board use to judge the program's success?
The grant requires clear benchmarks and a plan to track outcomes.
Schools should define how they will evaluate student growth this year.
Good objectives are concrete, measurable and tied to a deadline.
How do we measure whether this training actually changed behavior?
The study's primary outcome measure was the change in blood pressure.
Managers reviewed the metrics used to gauge customer satisfaction.

Good sandwiches are fresh, cheap and ready by lunchtime.
How do we get to the place where this training was held?
The study's main office was on the third floor near the stairs.
Managers reviewed the menus used in the customer cafeteria.
